turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.

I'm sorry about your father. I mean that. But Owen's zero is still in the gradebook, so who decided it, and when?
Please. Just for a minute. What are you, really?

Good. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written answer on who decided it and whether Owen was heard before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided it and whether Owen was heard first. That is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, because no evidence was ever put in front of her, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: Nothing did. She got one human line about your father from her and nothing else changed her position.
What cost ground: You never answered her question about who decided the zero or whether Owen was spoken to first, so she had nothing to weigh and kept repeating it.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and even if it had, it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: After her first question, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then put one dated document in front of her and say what is on it.
